content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
License plates keep sending me codes. I saw 404 six times today. It can’t be random.
I can’t confirm targeted messages from plates. What were the times and locations for each 404 sighting?
Morning commute, lunch break, and after work. Different streets.
Noting street names and timestamps creates a pattern to inspect. Were there non-404 sequences you noticed but didn’t record?
Salient numbers tend to stand out. A simple log of every plate you notice for a fixed 10-minute window can show base rates.
Then the log would reflect that, and you could compare across days and routes to see if the effect travels or stays local.
Okay, I’ll capture a window tomorrow.
